description:
Snakes & Ladders: The Ultimate Multiplayer Online Family Board Game!

Experience the classic fun of Snakes & Ladders and Ludo with a thrilling new twist! Roll the dream dice and embark on an exciting adventure across various ludo battlegrounds. The 2p player online board game to play!

Searching for a Snakes and Ladders 3D game? Look no further! This snake and ladder game is given a 3D effect for the experience.

Whether you’re playing against the computer, friends, or strangers online, this is the multiplayer online family board game to play.

Playing snakes and ladders on a board is safe. But what if you were chased by snakes in the jungles, pyramids, snow, and valleys? Could you survive?

Play our all-new Snakes & Ladders & Ludo game and find out. Go head-to-head against the computer, friends, or strangers online and see if you have what it takes to survive and win.

Play multiplayer offline and online board games. 
Snakes & Ladders is among the oldest games played in India, dating back to the 2nd century AD. We have given it a fresh makeover to make it more appealing in today's times. Our Snakes & Ladders game can be enjoyed by kids and adults alike. You can select from multiple battlegrounds and win against the snakes in thrilling battles.

Snake and Ladder is also known as ‘Chutes & Ladders’ in some countries. Whatever the name, the rules are all the same! Be the King and win the game. Snakes & Ladders' new app is a simple snake game race contest, and the one who reaches the top first is the Master or King. You have to roll the dice and play turn by turn with your friends or family. Have hours of fun while traveling by train, bus, or airplane now with Chutes & Ladders. No internet connection is required.

- CHOOSE YOUR COLOR: You can customize your avatar with your favorite color.
- PLAY OFFLINE: Play this snake and ladder game anytime and anywhere without an internet connection.
- MULTIPLAYER: Play with up to 4 players at a time. Select your game mode and start playing. The one who wins is the King or Master!
